[[File:Alusteel.png|thumb|right|Alusteel]]
'''Alusteel''' was an alloy used in [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Hull/Legends|hulls]]. It was known for its high durability, protecting ships with their shields disabled, such as the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]].
